deleteSql: WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM nooks_private.realtime_throttle t WHERE t.topic IN ('account:557b1ef6-f7c8-4986-8a84-29f52e402eed','account:d6b343ca-fa51-4ba0-8cb3-64b84560c2cf','nook:a4c67869-1edd-4acb-98ed-07b13eb4452a') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.nooks_accounts a WHERE 'account:'||a.id::text=t.topic) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.nooks_rooms r WHERE 'nook:'||r.id::text=t.topic) RETURNING t.topic) SELECT count(*) AS removed FROM removed;
